options.content:
# IREN_MKZ — Job Flight Recorder

**Live and historical flight recorder for Job `$jobid`.** Scheduler state and requested/allocated trays come directly from Slurm; NeMo/NCCL progress and final Llama windows come from bounded rank-0 parsing on the shared benchmark filesystem; hardware panels correlate those trays with GPU, power, thermal, cooling, Xid, host, and fabric evidence. For a pending job, tray telemetry is context for the requested placement—not usage by the job.

[Home](/d/iren_mkz-home?${__url_time_range}) · [Command Center](/d/iren_mkz-command-center?${__url_time_range}) · [Live Topology](/d/iren_mkz-topology?${__url_time_range}) · [Infrastructure](/d/iren_mkz-infrastructure?${__url_time_range}) · [GPU & NVLink](/d/iren_mkz-accelerators?${__url_time_range}) · [Fabric, CVT & Cabling](/d/iren_mkz-fabric?${__url_time_range}) · [Workloads, Slurm & Validation](/d/iren_mkz-workloads?${__url_time_range})

panels.description: Raw dmesg lines in the selected dashboard window, restricted to the exact Slurm tray roster for Job $jobid. Empty means Loki has no dmesg lines for those trays in this window; it is not reported as a healthy zero.
panels.title: dmesg — exact job-tray kernel events

panels.description: Actual deduplicated BMC SEL/EventLog entries observed during the selected window for the exact Slurm roster, newest observation first. Observed at is the central collector/Loki time; BMC event timestamp is retained exactly so BMC clock skew remains visible. No rows plus a green telemetry diagnostic below means no SEL events. A red diagnostic means SEL telemetry is unavailable for one or more selected trays; it must not be interpreted as a healthy zero.
panels.title: BMC SEL events — exact Job $jobid trays

panels.description: Zero means all selected job trays supplied Redfish SEL telemetry throughout the window, so an empty event table means NO SEL EVENTS. Any positive value means TELEMETRY UNAVAILABLE for that many job trays.

0.text: AVAILABLE — empty table means no events

panels.description: Rank-0 output is parsed once per completed file. Official means arithmetic mean over iterations 35-44 inclusive; steady means 10-50 inclusive.
